highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and expanded platform support.
highlights_body: It adds color font palettes, controllable surface sampling, zero-copy stream access, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. This preview also drops older Tizen and WebAssembly targets, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets removed
breaking.body: The WebAssembly packages no longer include native assets for Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later before upgrading.

breaking.title: 32-bit Tizen native assets removed
breaking.body: The Skia m147 update removes the EOL tizen-arm and tizen-x86 native assets. Move Tizen applications to the supported tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: The Vulkan YCbCr conversion info struct now follows the `GR` casing convention, and `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` uses the new type. Update source references to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; a compatibility shim remains for migration.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside Int32 range
breaking.body: The legacy `SKStream.Move(long)` overload now uses a checked conversion because the native API accepts a 32-bit offset. Use an Int32-range offset or handle `OverflowException` instead of relying on silent truncation.

breaking.title: Assembly version moved to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.lead: Skia updated from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances through m132 and m133 to m147, bringing newer image-codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, and accumulated raster and filter fixes.

bullets.lead: Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed
bullets.detail: libexpat moves to 2.7.5, libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface, SKFontArguments, and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, selecting design coordinates, choosing palettes, and overriding palette colors.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can control filtering and mipmapping.
SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or frame sequences to animated WebP through span-based frame APIs.
SKStream.GetData() returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it without copying.

bullets.lead: Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKDocument XPS creation overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, shader-backed mask filters, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and the HBColor value type.
Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android startup crashes and using an empty typeface when no system font is available.

bullets.lead: Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variation buffers now report and copy values correctly, and the byte-span ContainsGlyphs overload no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException.
SKPath no longer touches a finalized SKPathBuilder when garbage-collection order disposes the builder first.
SKGLView retains its dimensions when reattached, so returning to a MAUI TabBar page no longer produces a blank GL surface.
Apple libraries target the base 26.0 platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for Xcode 26.2.
New linux-bionic-x64 and linux-bionic-arm64 assets support Linux environments built on Android's Bionic libc.
Native packages add tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 assets alongside the platform transition away from 32-bit Tizen targets.
WebAssembly native packages retain Emscripten variants for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for older target frameworks.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled engine through Skia m147; adds variable fonts, color font palettes, controllable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets; and fixes Android typeface initialization and SKGLView reattachment. This preview removes 32-bit Tizen assets, and SKStream.Move now rejects offsets outside the Int32 range.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrects Apple library target frameworks.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Removes pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets, adds HBColor plus XPS, GPU flush, and shader mask-filter APIs, fixes NanoServer font initialization, and refreshes bundled image and font dependencies.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 with variable-font APIs, color font palette access, the HBColor value type, and native assets for Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
